"''Enjoy the fights.|Din Djarin and the Twi'lek doorman|}} A [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|male]] '''doorman''' worked at the [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk|Carnita arena]] when the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] visited to see the [[Abyssin]] [[gangster]] [[Gor Koresh]]. The doorman let Djarin in, but later helped Koresh's assailants fight the Mandalorian after Koresh attempted to steal Djarin's [[beskar]] [[Mandalorian armor|armor]]. Djarin defeated the Twi'lek and the rest of Koresh's assailants before intercepting the Abyssin. ==Biography== [[File:TwilekBouncerGutPunch-TMCh9.png|thumb|left|270px|The Twi'lek after taking a gut punch from Djarin.]] In [[9 ABY]],The events of "[[Chapter 9: The Marshal]]" took place in [[9 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]]. the [[Twi'lek]] worked as the doorman to an [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk|arena]] owned by the [[Abyssin]] [[gangster]] [[Gor Koresh]]''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' in a [[Warehouse district (Carnita arena)|warehouse district]]. One [[Standard day|day]], the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] came to an entrance to the arena, where the Twi'lek stood guard while a fight took place inside, and claimed that he wished to see Koresh. The doorman [[eye]]d the Mandalorian's [[foundling]], [[Din Grogu|Grogu]],{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 13: The Jedi}} before telling Djarin to enjoy the fights and allowing him through. Djarin negotiated with Koresh for information, but the Abyssin and his thugs attempted to steal the Mandalorian's [[beskar]] [[Mandalorian armor|armor]]. Being held at gunpoint, Djarin used [[whistling bird]]s to eliminate the thugs before being attacked by more of Koresh's assailants. The Twi'lek doorman grabbed the Mandalorian and held him towards his [[Zabrak]] comrade, who threw a punch at Djarin's head. Djarin's head threw back into the Twi'lek as a result, and the Mandalorian dealt two further blows to the doorman, incapacitating him. Djarin then defeated Koresh's remaining assailants and intercepted the Abyssin. ==Personality and traits== The doorman was a Twi'lek male with [[Color|dark]] skin and brown eyes. He gave a glance at the infant Grogu when Din Djarin visited the fighting pit. ==Equipment== The Twi'lek [[Clothing|wore]] dark colored clothing and robes with yellow features and a brown satchel bag. ==Behind the scenes== The Twi'lek doorman appeared in the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|premiere]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[October 30]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-october-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in October 2020}} Credited as "Twi'lek Doorman," the character was portrayed by [[Isaac C. Singleton]]. ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 9: The Marshal}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 1|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-9-the-marshal-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 9: The Marshal"}} {{Qo}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Portero twi'lek no identificado |fr=Vigile Twi'lek non-identifié |ka=უცნობი ტვი'ლეკი მეკარე }} [[Category:Criminals]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Twi'leks]]
